set.body:
Stage 2 of the post-closeout NumPy performance plan.

First preserve the default numerical contract while exposing independent work: interleave independent 128-value block accumulators for full reductions and independent row/fiber accumulators for axis-1 reductions without changing order within any block or the merge tree. Then dispatch mutable kernels once per dtype, operation, storage, and layout; remove ProbeApi get/set, tuple matching, boxing, and operation matching from hot element loops. Extend monomorphic binary/unary/scalar kernels only where the Stage 1 matrix demonstrates a gap.

Acceptance: adversarial bitwise tests prove unchanged default reduction results on JVM and Scala.js; aliasing, negative-stride, broadcast, overflow, and mutation-locality laws remain green; JMH controls compare the prior exact schedule with the exact ILP schedule; allocation does not scale per element; results and regressions are recorded for JDK 21 and JDK 25.
set.title: Exploit exact scalar ILP and remove mutable-loop dispatch
